newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cho Hung Bank US$200 mln FRN closes.
newsitem.headline: Cho Hung Bank US$200 mln FRN closes.

text.p: Cho Hung Bank's US$200 million Euro 144A floating rate notes issue due December 1999 has closed, the arrangers said.
The three-year notes were issued and re-offered at par to float at 20 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 10 basis points split as five basis points for management and underwriting and five basis points for selling.
Citibank International and Fuji International Finance (HK) are arrangers and lead managers.
SBC Warburg and Yamaichi (HK) are senior co-lead managers.
Bear Stearns, CDC, Chase Manhattan Asia, Commerzbank London, CS First Boston, Morgan Stanley, Nikko, Sal Oppenheim and Union Bank of Switzerland are co-lead managers.
